scope: Local actual Chrome hardware-rendered final package checks. Remote CI and deployment have separate receipts; this record does not claim public-site verification.

generatedSourceAudit.scope: Read-only generated-data and pixel-preservation audit. This is not a screenshot or performance verdict. Only this report was written by this check.

sourceReference.note: Actual original Unity Play-mode captures, no resampling or recoloring. Pixel checks cover quiet pause-panel regions; composition is also visually reviewed, not whole-image pixel equality.

ordinary.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics (0x0000A78B) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

tutorialCompletion.method: Unmodified production package. Normal R/D/A/Space input, authored trap/button/win log cues, and bounded moves at the original speed5. No QA keys or private game-state reads.

measurement.input: Unmodified production TCPAK, ordinary keyboard and player UI input. This smoke run does not claim completion of all levels.
measurement.cpu: Synchronous iframe host rAF callback and nested PlayerFrame wall duration; includes WASM game/update/render submission and instrumentation overhead.
measurement.intervals: Differences between consecutive engine-calling rAF timestamps, measured separately from CPU duration. Cadence is not proof of completed GPU/compositor presentation or end-to-end input latency.
measurement.scope: Hardware, viewport, phase, package and engine hashes are recorded. No universal frame-rate threshold is enabled unless explicitly configured.

levels.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics (0x0000A78B) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

level3Mechanics.method: QA navigation selects Level3 before this route. F8 only reads state. R/A/D/Space/P are the only gameplay mutations; real spikes, boxes, stairs and goal are used.

levels.caveat: Four-second idle and four-second movement phases for each of seven stages in two starting realms. CPU callback durations and rAF cadence are separate. No concurrent team build/GPU tests during timing; other system activity is not fully controlled. This is not proof of display presentation rate or all-device zero frame drops.

editor.note: Actual native Tilemap Cells delete/undo/redo, save under the unchanged 30-second assertion and page reload using an isolated cloud API fixture. Does not claim a real internet upload speed.

limitations: Native Tilemap collision still uses the supplied sync:maps tool after cell edits.
Texture readiness is native-GPU based; font warmup retains the Web-tested three-tick sequence, not a guarantee for all desktop worker congestion.
Natural gameplay completion checks cover the tutorial and Level3-to-Level4; all fourteen stage/realm states are exercised separately, not a continuous full-game completion.
